items.markdown:
A **design system** is `a complete set of standards, reusable UI components, design tokens, and documentation that acts as a single source of truth to build digital products consistently at scale`.[[1]](https://www.figma.com/blog/design-systems-101-what-is-a-design-system/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Design_system)[[3]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/design-system-examples/)[[4]](https://www.untitledui.com/blog/what-is-a-design-system)[[5]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/design-systems-101/)

### Core Components of a Design System

- **Foundations (Visual DNA):** Rules for color palettes, typography scales, spacing grids, elevation shadows, and icons.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DK9JF20tndO/?hl=en)
- **Design Tokens:** Variables (such as Figma variables or code tokens) that store visual attributes like surface colors, text roles, or corner radiuses instead of hardcoded values.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lsgVRCJ4fko)
- **Component Library:** Reusable, coded UI building blocks like buttons, inputs, dropdowns, and cards.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DK9JF20tndO/?hl=en)
- **Pattern Library:** Layout guidelines and repeatable user experience flows (such as forms, modals, and error states).[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DK9JF20tndO/?hl=en)
- **Documentation & Guidelines:** Usage rules, content strategies, do's and don'ts, and accessibility standards (WCAG).[[1]](https://www.contentful.com/blog/design-system-explained/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DK9JF20tndO/?hl=en)

### Why Design Systems Matter

- **Consistency:** Keeps the visual identity and user experience uniform across every screen and platform.[[1]](https://www.untitledui.com/blog/what-is-a-design-system)
- **Speed:** Speeds up design handoffs and developer implementation through prebuilt code and components.[[1]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/design-system-examples/)[[2]](https://www.salesforce.com/blog/what-is-a-design-system/)
- **Scalability:** Reduces design debt and allows new team members to contribute immediately.[[1]](https://www.untitledui.com/blog/what-is-a-design-system)

Popular industry examples include **Google Material Design**, **IBM Carbon**, **Apple HIG** , and **Atlassian Design System** . You can explore structured resources on platforms like [Figma Blog](https://www.figma.com/blog/design-systems-101-what-is-a-design-system/) and [Nielsen Norman Group](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/design-systems-101/).[[1]](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/design-system-examples/)[[2]](https://www.figma.com/blog/design-systems-101-what-is-a-design-system/)[[3]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/design-systems-101/)If you'd like, let me know:

- **What product or platform** you are building (web, mobile, enterprise app)
- **What stage** your team is in (starting from scratch vs. auditing an existing UI kit)

I can help you outline a step-by-step roadmap to build or adopt a design system.
